findings.claim: FY2026 分段營收：A&D $847M(17%)、Healthcare/Life Sciences $1,933M(39%)、Industrial $2,185M(44%)，總 $4,965M，前一年 $4,033M；Q4 Industrial $691M(48%) 對 Q3 $589M、去年同期 $461M。
Q4 FY2026 A&D $224M 較 Q3 $233M 下滑；Healthcare $512M 對 Q3 $483M。
公司指引 FY2027 營收中到高十位數成長；Q1 FY2027 營收 $1.410–1.460B。
findings.excerpt: We now expect mid- to upper-teens revenue growth with increasing operating margin and sustained working capital efficiency.

findings.claim: FY2027 初步展望：A&D 至少中個位數成長、Healthcare/Life Sciences 放緩至至少中個位數(消化期)，Industrial 受半導體設備需求帶動；top-10 客戶占 56%。
findings.source: MarketBeat Plexus Q3 earnings call highlights
